title: Celebrations & the 'x' sound

scenes.t: {name} talks about celebrations in Egypt with the teacher.
Eid Al-Fitr comes after Ramadan. We wear new clothes and visit our family.
I love Sham El-Nessim, as we go to the garden all day, play, and eat salted fish.
On Mother's Day we give our mothers gifts and say 'thank you'.
My favourite celebration is the 6th of October. It reminds us how brave the Egyptian soldiers are.
The letter x can sound like /gz/: exam, exit, example, examine, exist.
Riddle: I start with E and have an X. I'm where you leave. What am I? An exit!

items.a: Spring day: garden, play, salted fish.
We remember the brave Egyptian soldiers.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the celebration with what we do.
pairs: eat salted fish in the garden

activities.title: Has the /gz/ sound?
activities.prompt: Does the word have the x = /gz/ sound?

why.n: There is no x sound here.

items.q: We eat salted fish in the garden on…
The 6th of October reminds us of…
I start with E and have an X. I'm where you leave.
I ask you questions, big and small. You have to answer them all.

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 32–35
